license: none stated (repo README: "Benchmark data source for testing MedHELM"); notes originate from mtsamples.com
split: whole set (test only): mtsamples_processed (treatment-plan task) + mtsample_procedure (procedures task)
request_fields: instruction (generate treatment plan) + note text with PLAN section removed (reference = PLAN > SUMMARY > FINDINGS line)
notes: Pinned to the commit HELM uses for mtsamples_replicate (ebc104a4f96c5b7602242f301e081e9934a23344); the blob SHAs of both folders are identical at repo HEAD 52ba5528fd1ff1c6ec4ad1d0850126836404e71f. mtsamples_processed has 1269 notes, of which 539 have a PLAN/SUMMARY/FINDINGS line and become items under HELM's rule (n_items). HELM lists files with the GitHub contents API, which returns at most 1,000 entries, so a MedHELM run may see fewer (427 eligible among the first 1,000 files by name). mtsample_procedure (MTSamples Procedures, merged into this row) has 429 notes, 131 eligible. The other repo files (.nii.gz volumes, PNG images, eICU sqlite, Medbullets copy) were not downloaded. BRIDGE and Medmarks use their own MTSamples-derived tasks (mtsamples, mtsamples-temporal); not checked here. Checked 2026-10-04; no LLMs or API keys used. | BRIDGE releases two further MTSamples tasks (MTS, MTS-Temporal) as instructions; they are components of this benchmark.

rendering.rule: Pooled components. MedHELM items: full mtsamples_replicate prompt exactly as HELM builds it (instruction, blank line, note with PLAN section removed, newline, final cue "Answer:"; notes without a PLAN/SUMMARY/FINDINGS line skipped as in HELM). BRIDGE MTS and MTS-Temporal: instruction, blank line, input.
rendering.template_source: https://github.com/stanford-crfm/helm/blob/63754d05db6f874e41a395880fb573890a13e791/src/helm/benchmark/run_specs/medhelm_run_specs.py (get_mtsamples_spec) and src/helm/benchmark/scenarios/mtsamples_replicate_scenario.py; BRIDGE items carry their own instruction
